propositions: A TOCTOU race in completion close reads HEAD independently during verify and sign steps, allowing an unrelated commit to land between them
When HEAD drifts between verify and sign, the sign step correctly refuses to attest but the close transition proceeds anyway, leaving the ticket closed without a completion attestation
The current suggested recovery (re-close) is a no-op for already-closed tickets, with only --force-close or manual manifest fabrication available
The default no-ref path still reads HEAD twice and is susceptible to drift, while the 80af --ref fix only made the explicit-ref path coherent
A benign concurrent commit should not invalidate a completion attestation bound to the verified revision, per the same principle as 790c's plan-review fix
